purpose: Pause socket reads after Welcome to reproduce terrain/scene preparation on a slow client.
limits: Baseline is public Linux/ARM64 behind ingress; patched run is isolated native macOS. Same seed and 75-second unread interval, separate simulation starts and socket buffering. This tests connection recovery, not low-end rendering or a controlled performance benchmark.

regressions.burst: 1500 world snapshots and 375 wildlife snapshots with a real unread TCP peer; old code disconnected at tick 270, patched code preserves one terrain edit and the newest snapshots and answers Ping.
regressions.partial_write: A partly transmitted JSON snapshot completes before newer snapshots; ordered events survive replacement and byte accounting returns to zero.
regressions.event_limit: Reliable event backlogs still disconnect at the existing 8 MiB limit.
